key_points: Q3 2026 revenue miss driven by persistent weakness in the core advertising business.
Significant price target cuts from multiple analysts (Susquehanna, Aletheia, Tiger Securities, StoneX) due to margin and ad pressure.
Stock hitting 16-year lows reflects severe market skepticism over the valuation of AI investments.
Strong growth in AI Cloud Infrastructure (+94%) and GPU Cloud (+191%) provides a structural hedge but currently fails to offset core business decay.
Announcement of first-ever dividend suggests management is attempting to support the stock price amid fundamental headwinds.
